column1: # p477 star velocity, 2026-10-27. Gap 476-D asked for an interval long enough to be a velocity rather than a
# same-day delta. Method: TWO first-hand reads of the SAME channel (authenticated search, repo: qualifier)
# at two times recorded by this pass, so both endpoints are ours and the interval is known exactly.
# CAUTION: these are small event counts. A Poisson 95% interval on 8 events is roughly 3.5-15.8, so the
# per-hour figure for DeepTutor is 47-177/h. The SIGN is reliable; the magnitude is one decimal place at best.
# Cross-check against p476's PUBLISHED figure (different method, longer interval, weaker because p476's own
# read time inside its pass is unknown; its commit at 09:07:27Z bounds the interval at >= 42.3 min):
# HKUDS/DeepTutor  p476=44531 -> p477(t2)=44638  delta=+107  interval >= 42.3 min  =>  rate <= 152/h
# The two methods agree on order of magnitude (90/h direct, <=152/h bound). Both say the CURRENT rate is
# roughly an order of magnitude above the 147/day lifetime average, i.e. this repo is still accelerating.
